headline: 723 hospitalised as 2 more die of dengue in 24 hours
summary: Total deaths this year have risen to 63, with over 21,000 cases recorded across Bangladesh.
details: At least two dengue patients died and 723 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
The deaths were reported from the Barishal and Khulna divisions, with one fatality in each region.
With these latest figures, the total number of dengue deaths in Bangladesh this year has risen to 63, while total cases have reached 21,550.
Currently, 1,593 dengue patients are receiving treatment at various hospitals across the country.

headline_marked: Powerful [[bomb in pressure cooker defused]] in Savar
headline: Powerful bomb in pressure cooker defused in Savar
summary: A device wrapped in black tape was found in an open field beside a mosque; a loud blast shook the neighborhood during neutralization.
details: A powerful bomb hidden inside a pressure cooker was recovered and defused in Savar today. The device, wrapped in black tape, was found in an open field beside the Laltek Ghora Mosque.
Local residents discovered the pressure cooker inside a blue plastic drum last night. They removed it from the drum and placed it on the field before alerting authorities.
Police arrived at the scene around 8:00 am today after receiving an emergency call. They immediately cordoned off the area and called in the Dhaka Metropolitan Police's (DMP) Bomb Disposal Unit.
The Bomb Disposal Unit reached the scene at 1:45 pm and ordered the evacuation of the entire surrounding area for safety.
The device was neutralized at approximately 3:28 pm. A loud blast occurred during the process, which shook the area and triggered panic among residents.
Savar Police Station Inspector (Investigation) Nur Mohammad stated that the bomb was very powerful, and senior officials will provide further details in a briefing.
